kept: Then he remembered the hands held out for the chains. His friend had trusted him without asking for another promise.
Water dripped from a crack in the rock. Melos drank, pushed himself onto his knees, and stood.

He managed one step, then took another.

The murderer, she realized, had been his own brother all along.
The ship arrived at the island at dawn, and the crew finally saw the lost village.
Mira polished her sword before the morning lesson.
